title: Sealed Coffin
summary: Rust/WASM source for a second-price sealed-bid auction on Ootle. Equal deposits and salted commitments conceal bid amounts until reveal; payouts use stealth outputs. Revealed bids, deposit sizes and timing are public. Unrevealed bids forfeit their deposit; losing the one-time key loses access to the refund. The lot remains off-chain. On October 16, 2026, the README states that the template has in-process engine tests and is not yet deployed to Esmeralda. MIT; tari_template_lib 0.34.0 and test tooling 0.45.0 with a committed compatibility lock. Source/docs review only; no auction or transaction executed. The creator-linked Reddit announcement was marked removed by Reddit filters on October 16; the public forum submission remains readable.
cardSummary: Explore a sealed-bid auction template with equal deposits, timed reveals and stealth refunds.
